meta_description:
98K likes, 785 comments - kunalkemmu on October 6, 2026: "The request: 25 
The reply: 33 
I realised just like my trainer forgot the count in the end, the last video cut off at the 31.5 pull up 
So here is the complete video. 
This is my personal best today 
But even I started with  5 to 8 reps max 
The idea is to keep at it and keep adding a few reps every now and then. Just like weights in weight training exercises 
#stepbysteprepbyrep 
We just need to strive towards being a better version of ourself each day. There are no shortcuts, atleast not long term ones. Life is not a sprint it’s a marathon".
